<p dir="auto">A local, all-in-one LLM observability stack that combines <a href="https://github.com/comet-ml/opik">Opik</a>, <a href="https://github.com/Arize-ai/phoenix">Phoenix</a>, and <a href="https://mitmproxy.org/" rel="nofollow">mitmproxy</a> around a generic LLM proxy that works with any provider.</p>
<p dir="auto">Point your agents, SDKs, or tools at the LLM proxy and get full visibility into every API call.</p>
<p dir="auto">Provider API keys can be optionally configured at the <code>llm-proxy</code> level.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">What's Included</h2><a id="user-content-whats-included" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: What's Included" href="#whats-included"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Default stack (always running):</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>llm-proxy</strong> — Generic LLM API reverse proxy with path-based routing, API key management, and configurable OTEL trace export</li>
<li><strong>mitmproxy</strong> — Transparent HTTPS proxy with web UI for raw traffic inspection</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Optional:</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>phoenix</strong> — Phoenix UI and OTEL collector (<code>phoenix</code> profile)</li>
<li><strong>Opik</strong> — Trace/span visualization and analysis UI</li>
<li><strong>claude-sdk-chat</strong> — Claude Agent SDK chat UI (<code>claude-chat</code> profile)</li>
<li><strong>claude-sdk-proxy</strong> — Anthropic API proxy with caching (<code>claude-proxy</code> profile)</li>
<li><strong>claude-code</strong> — Claude Code CLI container (<code>claude-code</code> profile)</li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">How To Use It</h2><a id="user-content-how-to-use-it" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: How To Use It" href="#how-to-use-it"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Agent Super Spy was created to solve one of the biggest pain points of local agent development:</p>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">How to see exactly what LLM calls and network traffic is generated by the agents.</p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">The mitmproxy can be used to capture all network traffic for a container or used as a
passthrough proxy for local development. Point your HTTP client at the proxy:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="# Route all traffic through mitmproxy for inspection
export HTTP_PROXY=http://localhost:8080
export HTTPS_PROXY=http://localhost:8080

# Or route only LLM calls through the llm-proxy (exports traces via OTEL)
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000/anthropic
export OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000/openai"><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Route all traffic through mitmproxy for inspection</span>
<span class="pl-k">export</span> HTTP_PROXY=http://localhost:8080
<span class="pl-k">export</span> HTTPS_PROXY=http://localhost:8080

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Or route only LLM calls through the llm-proxy (exports traces via OTEL)</span>
<span class="pl-k">export</span> ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000/anthropic
<span class="pl-k">export</span> OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000/openai</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">For HTTPS inspection, install the mitmproxy CA certificate (auto-generated on first run)
so your client trusts the intercepted connections. See the
<a href="https://docs.mitmproxy.org/stable/concepts-certificates/" rel="nofollow">mitmproxy docs</a> for details.</p>
<p dir="auto">For LLM logging, the <code>llm-proxy</code> transparently exports traces to the configured OTEL targets
and also sends traffic through the mitmproxy. Opik or Phoenix lets you inspect traces.
Mitmproxy lets you see the exact headers and request payloads.</p>
<p dir="auto">The optional claude services (containers) act as reference implementations for how to run
agents in Docker containers and auto capture all outbound traffic.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>The general use pattern:</strong></p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Start the stack</li>
<li>Configure your agents (local or in other containers) to use the llm-proxy as the base URL</li>
<li>View traces in Opik or Phoenix and raw traffic in mitmproxy web UI</li>
</ol>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">LLM Proxy Routing</h2><a id="user-content-llm-proxy-routing" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: LLM Proxy Routing" href="#llm-proxy-routing"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The proxy uses path-based routing. Set your SDK's base URL to route through the proxy:</p>
<markdown-accessiblity-table><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Provider</th>
<th>Base URL</th>
<th>Example</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Anthropic</td>
<td><code>http://localhost:4000/anthropic</code></td>
<td><code>/anthropic/v1/messages</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>OpenAI</td>
<td><code>http://localhost:4000/openai</code></td>
<td><code>/openai/v1/chat/completions</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Any hostname</td>
<td><code>http://localhost:4000/<hostname></code></td>
<td><code>/api.openrouter.com/v1/messages</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></markdown-accessiblity-table>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Generic routing:</strong> If the first path segment contains a <code>.</code>, it's treated as a hostname and forwarded to <code>https://<hostname>/remaining/path</code>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">API Key Management</h2><a id="user-content-api-key-management" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: API Key Management" href="#api-key-management"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The proxy supports transparent API key swapping via <code>keys.jsonc</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-json-comments notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="{
  "my-local-key": {
    "anthropic": "sk-ant-real-key...",
    "openai": "sk-real-key...",
    "api.openrouter.com": "sk-or-real-key..."
  }
}"><pre>{
  <span class="pl-ent">"my-local-key"</span>: {
    <span class="pl-ent">"anthropic"</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>sk-ant-real-key...<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>,
    <span class="pl-ent">"openai"</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>sk-real-key...<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>,
    <span class="pl-ent">"api.openrouter.com"</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>sk-or-real-key...<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
  }
}</pre></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>How it works:</strong></p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Your SDK sends requests with <code>x-api-key: my-local-key</code> (or <code>Authorization: Bearer my-local-key</code>)</li>
<li>The proxy looks up <code>my-local-key</code> in <code>keys.jsonc</code></li>
<li>Finds the real key for the target provider</li>
<li>Swaps it before forwarding to the upstream API</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">If the key isn't found in <code>keys.jsonc</code>, it's passed through as-is (assumed to be a real key).</p>
<p dir="auto">Reload keys without restarting: <code>docker kill --signal=HUP <llm-proxy-container></code></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Connecting Other Projects</h2><a id="user-content-connecting-other-projects" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Connecting Other Projects" href="#connecting-other-projects"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Add the shared network to your project's <code>docker-compose.yml</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-yaml notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="networks:
  llm-proxy-net:
    name: llm-proxy-net    # or your configured NETWORK_NAME
    external: true

services:
  my-agent:
    networks:
      - default
      - llm-proxy-net
    environment:
      ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: http://llm-proxy:4000/anthropic"><pre><span class="pl-ent">networks</span>:
  <span class="pl-ent">llm-proxy-net</span>:
    <span class="pl-ent">name</span>: <span class="pl-s">llm-proxy-net    </span><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> or your configured NETWORK_NAME</span>
    <span class="pl-ent">external</span>: <span class="pl-c1">true</span>

<span class="pl-ent">services</span>:
  <span class="pl-ent">my-agent</span>:
    <span class="pl-ent">networks</span>:
      - <span class="pl-s">default</span>
      - <span class="pl-s">llm-proxy-net</span>
    <span class="pl-ent">environment</span>:
      <span class="pl-ent">ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL</span>: <span class="pl-s">http://llm-proxy:4000/anthropic</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">From the shared network, these host names are available:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>llm-proxy:4000</code> — LLM proxy</li>
<li><code>mitmproxy-ui:8081</code> — mitmproxy web UI</li>
<li><code>phoenix:6006</code> - Phoenix OTEL collector (if Phoenix enabled)</li>
<li><code>opik-backend:8080</code> — Opik API (if Opik enabled)</li>
<li><code>opik-frontend:5173</code> — Opik UI (if Opik enabled)</li>
</ul>
